metadata.case_name: HO MAN WA v. WONG SHUI FUN T/A YAU LEE CO AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fracture at shaft of the right femur
source: X-ray also showed fracture at shaft of the right femur.

injuries.description: heterotopic ossification at the tip of the greater trochanter of the right hip
source: For the X-ray of the right hip, heterotopic ossification was noted at the tip of the greater trochanter (which was the entry site for insertion of intramedullary nail), corresponding to the site of maximal tenderness and pain complained by the Plaintiff.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: swelling and tenderness over the right thigh
the Plaintiff might still have some residual pain in his right hip and knee
full range of movement of right hip and knee with no pain
there were also several surgical scars over the lateral aspect of right hip
able to squat fully with no pain; walking and running with normal gait; and sitting and standing with no limitation

treatments_received.treatment: closed reduction and internal fixation with IM nail
source: Emergency operation, namely closed reduction and internal fixation with IM nail was performed on the same day.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for fracture of femur +/- internal fixation

source: the Plaintiff was readmitted to the Princess Margaret Hospital for removal of implant in December 2006.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Removal of screw, pin and plate, and other metal for old fracture except fracture femur

source: the Plaintiff had attended 2 courses of physiotherapy with a total of 47 sessions.

losses.description: the Plaintiff might still have some residual pain in his right hip and knee
there were also several surgical scars over the lateral aspect of right hip. These scars were however non-tender.
